title: Reading Drill — The Changing Hours of a Street Fountain
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: The Changing Hours of a Street Fountain
passages.body:
**A** A shopping street's fountain was expensive to keep running all day. Before shortening its operating hours, the town placed observers nearby to see when people stopped rather than simply walked past.

**B** The busiest hour was earlier on hot days. The same observers also noticed that the sound masked nearby traffic noise, which was particularly noticeable after office workers left.

**C** The town introduced a flexible schedule. On the quietest days, it timed the fountain to switch off just after the last bus departure, rather than running until a fixed late hour.

questions.prompt: Before shortening its operating hours, the town placed ______ nearby to see when people stopped rather than simply walked past.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Before shortening its operating hours, the town placed observers nearby to see when people stopped rather than simply walked past.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: The same observers also noticed that the sound masked nearby traffic noise, which was particularly noticeable after office workers left.

questions.prompt: On the quietest days, it timed the fountain to switch off just after the last ______, rather than running until a fixed late hour.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: On the quietest days, it timed the fountain to switch off just after the last bus departure, rather than running until a fixed late hour.

questions.prompt: The fountain was operated for the same hours every day under the new schedule.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The town introduced a flexible schedule. On the quietest days, it timed the fountain to switch off just after the last bus departure, rather than running until a fixed late hour.
